description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.


The Estimating Lead owns cost estimating for Lambda's portfolio of greenfield data center campuses and leased data center sites across the United States. The role reports to the Senior Director of Project Controls.

The Estimating Lead sets the standards, methods, and data for every capital estimate in the portfolio, from early conceptual estimates for site selection through detailed control estimates at final investment decision. The role produces and reviews estimates directly, and makes sure each one carries a clear basis of estimate, documented assumptions, and a range of accuracy suited to its stage.

The role brings recognized estimating practice, including the AACE International estimate classification system and Total Cost Management, to a fast-moving, capital-intensive AI infrastructure program. The successful candidate will make sure leadership can trust every number it approves, and that budgets and contingency rest on benchmarked historical data rather than rule of thumb.

The Estimating Lead partners closely with construction, engineering, procurement, real estate, energy, finance, and the other project controls disciplines. At Lambda, Project Controls is being built from first principles, so this role will build the estimating function, its cost database, and its methods to the level a multi-campus, multi-gigawatt capital program requires.


What You'll Do

Estimating Standards & Methodology

  • Establish the estimating standard for the portfolio: estimate classes, required deliverables, basis of estimate format, and review and approval steps, aligned with AACE recommended practices 17R-97 and 18R-97.

  • Align estimate classes with the capital stage-gate process, so each gate receives an estimate of the maturity and accuracy it requires.

  • Define the estimate structure in line with the standard code of accounts and WBS, so estimates, budgets, and actuals compare line for line.

  • Maintain estimating templates, procedures, and quality checklists, and build lessons learned back into them.

Estimate Development

  • Lead the preparation of conceptual, budget, and control estimates for greenfield campuses, building expansions, and leased data center fit-outs.

  • Develop parametric estimates using cost per MW of IT load, cost per square foot, and other data center benchmarks to support site selection and early investment decisions.

  • Prepare detailed estimates for civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing scopes, including utility interconnection, substations, and on-site power.

  • Estimate owner-furnished equipment, including switchgear, generators, transformers, UPS, and cooling equipment, with current market pricing and lead-time escalation.

  • Apply escalation, market conditions, labor availability, and location factors across US markets.

  • Document every estimate with a basis of estimate, assumptions, exclusions, and expected accuracy range.

Benchmarking & Cost Data

  • Build and maintain Lambda's historical cost database, using actual costs from completed projects and market data.

  • Benchmark estimates and contractor pricing against internal history and industry data for hyperscale and mission-critical facilities.

  • Track market trends for key materials, equipment, and labor, and advise leadership on their effect on the program.

Bid Review & Procurement Support

  • Prepare independent owner's estimates to evaluate contractor and vendor bids.

  • Lead bid leveling and scope gap analysis, and support procurement and commercial teams in negotiation.

  • Review GMP proposals, design-build pricing, and major change order pricing for completeness and reasonableness.

Risk, Contingency & Value Engineering

  • Partner with Program Services on quantitative cost risk analysis to set contingency and management reserve.

  • Lead estimate reviews at each stage gate with engineering, construction, and finance.

  • Price design alternatives and value engineering options to support design and investment decisions.

Leadership

  • Build and lead the estimating team, and manage third-party estimating consultants where needed.

  • Present estimates, key cost drivers, and risks clearly to senior leadership and investment decision-makers.

  • Coach and develop estimators as the portfolio scales.

You

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related discipline.

  • Professional credentials such as AACE CEP or CCP, ASPE CPE, or RICS chartered status are strongly preferred.

  • Typically 8+ years of experience in cost estimating on large construction or capital projects, including experience leading estimates or an estimating team.

  • Expert in conceptual, parametric, and detailed estimating across all major trades, with deep knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems.

  • Strong working knowledge of the AACE estimate classification system and basis of estimate practice.

  • Experience preparing independent owner's estimates, leveling bids, and reviewing GMP and change order pricing.

  • Experience building and using historical cost databases and benchmarks.

  • Proficiency with estimating tools such as Destini Estimator, Sage Estimating, Bluebeam, or equivalent, plus advanced Excel.

  • Experience on greenfield construction and MEP-intensive facilities; hyperscale or mission-critical data center experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain cost drivers and assumptions clearly to executives.

Nice to Have

  • Hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or mission-critical data center development.

  • Experience estimating utility interconnection, high-voltage substations, or on-site power generation.

  • Experience building an estimating function or cost database from the ground up.

  • Experience with multi-billion-dollar capital programs or portfolios.

  • Experience with stage-gate or Front-End Loading (FEL) capital governance.

  • Experience with EPC, design-build, GMP, or other major delivery models.

  • Experience estimating across multiple US markets.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

  • Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

  • Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

  • We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

  • Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

  • We offer generous cash & equity compensation

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

  • Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

  • 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

  • Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer
